You choose; Claude plans; GPT builds

Decisions and implementation have named responsibilities.You choose each chat’s model and model changes. Programs keep records and check state.

Discussion and decisions keep their records

The discussion is shared; private chats are kept by peer.Research questions and implementation choices stay in exchange records; progress events go to the appropriate chat.

Claude reviews each delivery before acceptance

Tasks name the delivery; review determines acceptance.Requested changes return to GPT; accepted results enter the result tree.

Programs observe; chat tools wake assistants

Observation and model work run separately.The watcher writes events and the scheduler advises patrols. Assistants use the host’s available tools; optional bridges deliver events.

Claude reviews research; you authorize actions

GPT completes routine implementation within scope.Claude reviews choices beyond that scope. Account actions and external commitments follow your current authorization.

Continue work; record concrete dependencies

Each role checks messages, events and tasks.With separate chats, experiments handle jobs, front desk handles messages, and chores handles pages and documents. Continue until a concrete dependency remains.
